{{Top|leg}}
'''Shi'lin''' was a former [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Shi'lin's crew used [[Z2 Stun Baton/Legends|Z2 stun batons]] to control their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and never used the lethal force setting because property damage meant lower profits.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
